title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2608.15567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). translated_title: SchurQuant：面向逐层大语言模型量化的分组离散优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15567v1 公告类型：新 摘要：仅权重的训练后量化（PTQ）能够在紧凑的内存预算下部署大型语言模型，但在2-3位精度下准确性常常崩溃。现有的免反向传播PTQ优化器存在两个局限性：分组决策忽略了剩余连续后缀可以吸收的修正，且离散细化通常保持仿射量化网格固定。我们引入了SCHUROPT，它解析性地消除了后缀的最优连续响应，得到具有Schur补曲率的精确分组二次函数。然后，它交替进行闭式逐行缩放/零点重拟合与整数码上的坐标下降。在固定GPTQ目标下，SCHUROPT将2位Qwen3-4B的平均零样本准确性提高了11.88个百分点（pp）。然而，在更高精度下，更紧致的重构并不一致地改善端模型指标。因此，SCHURQUANT将SCHUROPT与量化后处理相结合。
tldr: 本文提出SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT方法，通过解析消除连续后缀响应并结合闭式缩放与整数坐标下降，显著提升低比特权重量化的准确性，尤其在2位精度下带来大幅改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCHUROPT and SCHURQUANT, which analytically eliminate the continuous suffix response and combine closed-form scaling with integer coordinate descent, significantly improving low-bit weight quantization accuracy, especially at 2-bit precision.
